indicator_name: Tangible fixed assets, gross (original cost), start of year
description: Основные средства (материальные), первоначальная стоимость на начало года
methodology: Billion KZT, gross stock (original cost) at the start of the year. Tangible fixed assets («Основные средства», Taldau term 455728, intangibles excluded) of all enterprises, form 11, national, from 2000. Historical-cost book values incl. revaluations -- not a volume measure. Taldau 703203.
